answer_text: Per the ILMM Service Levels, Service Level Credits are calculated as a percentage of total ILMM fees for the affected Site and are capped at 15% of the fees payable per Site per month. For a monthly ILMM fee of $18,000, the maximum credit per site per month is $2,700 (15% of $18,000). Therefore, a requested $3,600 credit would exceed the cap and the credit eligible for August would be limited to $2,700, subject to eligibility under the ILMM SLA. If you want, I can escalate this for a formal confirmation against INC-4471 and apply the credit per policy.
